canonical.title: A Vienna weekend, built around the Michelin reservation

siblings.title: Things to do in Vienna
siblings.summary: Schönbrunn morning + Belvedere afternoon, Stephansdom + Hofburg + a real coffee house. Refuse every wig-and-coat Mozart tout.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Vienna
siblings.summary: Six restaurants carry 2+ Michelin stars in Vienna for 2026 — pick by cuisine, room and budget.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events in Vienna
siblings.summary: Major 2026 conferences, recurring meetups, and where to find them.

sources.title: wien.info — luxury restaurants
sources.claim: Only Amador and Doubek take a Saturday seating; Steirereck, Konstantin Filippou, Mraz & Sohn, Silvio Nickol close weekends or weekdays only.

sources.title: Restaurant Amador
sources.claim: Amador, 3 Michelin stars, Grinzingerstraße 86, 1190 Wien.

sources.title: Amador HAPPY END menu
sources.claim: Amador's signature HAPPY END menu lists at €395.

sources.title: Restaurant Doubek
sources.claim: Doubek, 2 Michelin stars, Kochgasse 13, 1080 Wien.

sources.title: Doubek review — Copenhagen Foodie
sources.claim: Doubek's 18-course menu (10 savoury + 4 desserts plus extras) costs €300; four wood-fuelled fire sources, no conventional stove.

sources.title: Steirereck im Stadtpark
sources.claim: Steirereck, promoted to 3 Michelin stars in 2026, closes weekends.

sources.title: Konstantin Filippou
sources.claim: Konstantin Filippou, 2 Michelin stars, 7–9 course set menu, no à la carte, weekdays only.

sources.title: Mraz & Sohn
sources.claim: Mraz & Sohn, 2 stars, 13-course surprise tasting menu, family business approaching 30 years.

sources.title: Silvio Nickol Gourmet Restaurant
sources.claim: Silvio Nickol inside Palais Coburg; ~60,000-bottle wine cellar.

sources.title: Schönbrunn Palace tickets
sources.claim: Schönbrunn Grand Tour €38, ~75 min, 40 rooms, audio guide; timed slot mandatory.

sources.title: Belvedere — Visit
sources.claim: Upper Belvedere €23, Lower €20, combined €32; timed slot ticket mandatory; Upper opens 09:00.

sources.title: Stephansdom South Tower
sources.claim: Stephansdom South Tower: 343-step climb (no lift) to 67m with panoramic views.

sources.title: Stephansdom catacombs
sources.claim: Stephansdom catacombs tours run hourly-ish Mon–Sat from 10:00 and Sun afternoons; 25–30 min, Ducal Chamber with Rudolf IV's tomb.

sources.title: Hofburg — Sisi Museum tickets
sources.claim: Standard Hofburg day ticket bundles Sisi Museum + Imperial Apartments for €20 adult.

sources.title: Kunsthistorisches Museum
sources.claim: KHM €22 online / €24 on-site for adults; Tue–Sun 10–18, Thursday until 21:00.

sources.title: Leopold Museum opening hours
sources.claim: Leopold Museum opens Wed–Sun 10–18, Thursday until 21:00; closed Mon/Tue.

sources.title: Albertina tickets
sources.claim: Albertina €19.90 adult; daily 10–18, Wed/Fri until 21:00.

sources.title: Wiener Staatsoper 2025/26 season
sources.claim: Vienna State Opera season runs 3 Sept 2025 – 30 June 2026 (closes with Il Trittico).

sources.title: Stehplatz tickets guide — Moon Honey Travel
sources.claim: Stehplatz tickets sell online from 10:00 on show day; €13–€18; max 2 per transaction.

sources.title: Oper live am Platz
sources.claim: Free 50 m² LED broadcast on Herbert-von-Karajan-Platz, ~180 chairs; April–June and September.

sources.title: UNESCO — Viennese coffee house culture
sources.claim: Vienna coffee houses: 'a place where time and space are consumed, but only the coffee is on the bill.'

sources.title: Café Central closure — Chill Report
sources.claim: Café Central closed 16 March 2026 for 150th-anniversary renovation; reopens autumn 2026.

sources.title: wien.info — top traditional coffee houses
sources.claim: Café Sperl 'synonymous with Viennese coffee house culture since 1880'; Hawelka famous for Buchteln.

sources.title: Jewish Viennese Food — Kaffeehaus guide
sources.claim: Café Bräunerhof on Stallburggasse was Thomas Bernhard's regular salon, Vienna's best international newspaper selection.

sources.title: Naschmarkt — wien.info
sources.claim: Naschmarkt: ~130 stalls open Mon–Sat from 6am; Saturday flea-market 6:30am–2pm.

sources.title: Bitzinger Würstelstand
sources.claim: Bitzinger has run the Albertinaplatz Würstelstand since 1999.

sources.title: Würstelstand UNESCO listing
sources.claim: Viennese Würstelstand culture inscribed on UNESCO intangible-heritage list in 2024.

sources.title: Figlmüller
sources.claim: Figlmüller claims to have invented the Wiener Schnitzel in 1905; 30 cm pounded veal cutlet.

sources.title: Plachutta Wollzeile
sources.claim: Plachutta Wollzeile — original Tafelspitz address; boiled-beef in a copper pot.

sources.title: Mayer am Pfarrplatz
sources.claim: Mayer am Pfarrplatz in Nussdorf/Heiligenstadt; Heuriger since 1683; Beethoven once lived there.

sources.title: Vienna scams guide — Tabiji
sources.claim: Costumed 'Mozart' touts in powdered wigs sell €55–85 tickets to commission-rigged student-ensemble concerts.

sources.title: Wiener Hofburg Orchester
sources.claim: Legitimate Wiener Hofburg Orchester plays in the Hofburg's Zeremoniensaal and Konzerthaus Mozart-Saal Tue/Thu/Sat (May–mid October).

sources.title: Wiener Festwochen 2026
sources.claim: Wiener Festwochen 2026 runs 28 May – 22 June (75th anniversary, theme 'Republic of Gods', 1000+ venues).

sources.title: RubyConf Austria 2026
sources.claim: RubyConf Austria 2026 runs 29–31 May in Vienna; main day at Das MuTh, Am Augartenspitz 1.

sources.title: Google Cloud Meetup Vienna
sources.claim: Google Cloud Meetup Vienna #36 — Thu May 28 2026 at weXelerate, Praterstraße 1.

sources.title: OWASP Global AppSec EU 2026
sources.claim: OWASP Global AppSec EU 2026: Jun 22–26 at Austria Center Vienna (training Jun 22–24, conference Jun 25–26).

sources.title: TEDAI Vienna 2026 program
sources.claim: TEDAI Vienna 2026: Oct 28–30 at the Hofburg; speakers include Geoffrey Hinton.

sources.title: WeAreDevelopers World Congress
sources.claim: WeAreDevelopers World Congress 2026 in Berlin (Jul 8–10), not Vienna.

sources.title: S7 airport train
sources.claim: S7 train from Vienna Airport to Wien Mitte: ~20–22 min, every 30 min, €5.40.

sources.title: Twin City Liner — Bratislava
sources.claim: Twin City Liner catamaran: Schwedenplatz to Bratislava in 75 min, up to 3 daily (1 May – 2 Nov 2026).

sources.title: Wiener Riesenrad
sources.claim: Wiener Riesenrad: daily 09:00–23:45, ~65m tall, €14.50, erected 1897 for Franz Joseph's 50th jubilee.

sources.title: Klimt in Vienna
sources.claim: Upper Belvedere holds the world's largest Klimt collection (24 paintings) including 'The Kiss'.
